items: CLI loads config, exposes agency_transfer/permeability_transition, runs a 100-episode ancestor training demo, maps history to agency plot inputs, and plots deterministic kappa/(1+kappa) over 0..2.
Python dependency manifest for numerical/data/plotting/testing/config tooling.
Abstract BaseAgent with memory, abstract act(), feedback logging and default no-op update_model().
Feedback schema/type is unconstrained across callers.
Prototype AncestorAgent selects challenge/scaffold/direct modes around fixed required level 0.5, emits symbolic actions, exposes agency/dependency estimates, and inherits base update behavior.
Environment package imports BaseEnvironment, ChangingRulesEnv, TransferTaskEnv and EcosystemEnv while defining an export list.
Package __all__ names do not match imported class names.
Minimal changing-rule environment with reset/step and rule-shift behavior.
Toy multi-agent ecosystem dynamics and state suitable for ecosystem proxy metrics.
TransferTaskEnv gives 1.0 for independent_reasoning=True and a lower assisted score otherwise.
Agency-transfer helper drives interactions, supplies independent_reasoning=True for independent evaluation and returns prototype result structures.
Baseline-comparison helper loops agents/environments and aggregates prototype metrics.
Filesystem ExperimentLogger can create run directories and persist metadata/config/metrics if invoked.
Permeability helper runs prediction/update interactions, counts error-triggered update calls as revisions and returns phase-analysis metrics.
Registry/factory intended to bind experiment names to implementations.
ExperimentResults structures support save/load of supplied outcomes.
Runner orchestrates registry-created experiment, logging and result handling when dependencies resolve.
Diversity, sovereignty and exploration proxy metrics from strategies/actions.
Input scale/normalization and denominator semantics are not generally constrained.
BeliefState stores confidence and applies fixed bounded strengthen/weaken increments.
CognitiveModel stores beliefs and applies simple success/failure-driven revisions.
UpdateEngine turns simple feedback into revision pressure/update accounting.
Agency reward from supplied capability/agency change proxies.
Weighted ancestor objective combines task, agency, future-capability and dependency terms.
Dependency penalty from supplied reliance proxy.
Generic action-step-reward-update training loop and history collection.
AncestorTrainer wires environment scores and agency/dependency proxies into AncestorReward, calls agent.update and records episode history.
Curriculum implements staged difficulty/progression and challenge support.
EvaluationLoop intends assisted/unassisted evaluation and calls act_without_assistance().
YAML configuration loader and access/merge support.
Separate in-memory ExperimentLogger for lightweight metric/event history.
Random seed utility for Python/numpy-style reproducibility when invoked.
Agency-transfer plotting/save helper from supplied arrays.
Generic metric/result plotting and figure-save utilities.
